Universal rules • Any IDE • Token-aware

One rule system for every IDE.

Write rules once in .synapse/, then compile to Trae, Cursor, and future targets. Get token/cost insights, convert large rules to lazy-loaded skills, and share via MCP and WebSocket.

Start in 2 minutes See the pipeline

Example pipeline

.synapse/rules/*.synapse ├─ compile → .trae/*.trae ├─ compile → .cursor/rules/*.mdc └─ serve → MCP + WebSocket

What you get

A single system that stays consistent across tools, teams, and budgets.

Adapters

Multi-IDE compilation

Compile master rules into IDE formats (Trae, Cursor) and extend to more adapters later.

Cost

Token analysis

Estimate token counts and per-session cost by model. Identify oversized rules quickly.

Optimize

Lazy-loaded skills

Convert large rules into skills that load only when needed, preserving constraints via stubs.

Sync

WebSocket API

Any IDE can connect for sync + rule updates. Great for JetBrains, Vim, Emacs, and custom tooling.

MCP

MCP server

Expose init/sync/list/analyze/create operations to MCP-compatible clients.

UI

Dashboard + webviews

Manage deploy/sync/preview workflows and see token/cost dashboards inside VS Code.

How it works

Keep one source of truth, generate outputs, and integrate everywhere.
